metadata.title: Pull QA Guidelines
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Read guideline files from the qa-guidelines ADO repository. This is a reusable step called multiple times in the create-test-plan process: once for sniffing guidelines and once for test case writing guidelines. Falls back to cloning the repo locally if direct file access fails.

output.description: Parsed guideline content stored in memory for downstream consumption

prerequisites: Access to Azure DevOps MCP tools
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Use mcp__azuredevops__repo_file to read files from the qa-guidelines repo
Files to read are specified in the template step guidance (varies per invocation)
For test case guidelines: test-plan-creation/test-case-writing.md, test-plan-creation/test-types-reference.md, test-plan-creation/test-case-metadata.md, test-plan-creation/examples.md
Fallback: If mcp__azuredevops__search_code or mcp__azuredevops__repo_file fails (e.g., unindexed repo), clone the repo locally to a temp directory and read files directly from the filesystem

read: memory.json (for process context and which files to read)
qa-guidelines repo files (via ADO MCP or local clone)

tools: mcp__azuredevops__repo_file - Read files from qa-guidelines repo
mcp__azuredevops__repo_repository - Get repo details if needed
mcp__azuredevops__search_code - Search for files in repo
git clone - Fallback: clone repo locally if MCP file access fails
read_file - Read files from local clone
bestPractices: Always try MCP file access first before falling back to local clone
Log which access method was used (MCP vs local clone)
Parse and structure guideline content for downstream use
Store full guideline text in memory since downstream steps need the complete content
When cloning locally, use a temp directory and note the path for cleanup

substeps.name: List directory in qa-guidelines repo
substeps.description: List the repository contents to verify file paths and availability
actions: Use mcp__azuredevops__repo_file to list the directory structure of the qa-guidelines repo (repoId: 9b4f0be0-9a6b-43d1-a3b1-fd5f73714b19)
Verify the target files exist at expected paths
If listing fails: note that fallback to local clone will be needed

substeps.name: Read specified guideline files
substeps.description: Read each guideline file specified in the template step guidance
actions: Read each file path specified in the template step's guidance.files array
If any file read fails: attempt fallback — clone repo locally to temp directory and read files from filesystem
Collect raw content from all files

substeps.name: Parse content and store in memory
substeps.description: Parse the raw guideline content and store structured data in memory
actions: Parse markdown content from each guideline file
Extract key sections, checklists, rules, and examples
Store parsed content in memory under guidelines object
Include file source paths for traceability
Note which access method was used (MCP direct vs local clone)

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: All specified guideline files were read and parsed
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: List repo directory to verify paths -> Read each specified guideline file via MCP -> If MCP fails, fallback to cloning repo locally -> Parse content and store in memory. This step is reusable: it is called twice in create-test-plan with different file lists.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Template step guidance for which files to read
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: guidelines object with parsed content from each file
fields: Information Produced: guidelines.content (parsed guideline text), guidelines.files (list of files read), guidelines.source (MCP or local clone)
Decisions Made: Access method (MCP vs local clone fallback)
Notes: Any files that failed to load, fallback usage
